title: The bundles coord serve hands out are signed with an HS256 key file, so OPA refuses a bundle changed on the way
goal: coord.py serve --bundle-key FILE (mode 0600, else exit 2 naming chmod 0600) adds /.signatures.json to each bundle: one HS256 JWT whose payload lists every file with its SHA-256 hash and the keyid kbjobs, as OPA's bundle signing format has it; the token verifies with the key file's bytes by the standard library's hmac, and a bundle whose file differs from its listed hash fails that verification; no --bundle-key serves unsigned bundles as before

run:
import sys,os,json,time,tempfile,subprocess
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
kd=os.path.join(d,"keys")
def key(p,t):
    f=os.path.join(kd,*p.split("/")); os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(f),exist_ok=True); open(f,"w").write(t); os.chmod(f,0o600); return f
import urllib.request,tarfile,io,hmac,hashlib,base64
a=key("corp/ops/jan.kowalski","ka-placeholder"); kf=os.path.join(d,"bundle.key"); open(kf,"w").write("bundle-key-placeholder"); os.chmod(kf,0o644)
pd=os.path.join(d,"pol"); os.makedirs(pd); open(os.path.join(pd,"placement.rego"),"w").write("package kbjobs.placement\n")
bad=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--store",os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"),"serve","--bind","127.0.0.1:0","--keys",kd,"--bundle-key",kf],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
assert bad.returncode==2 and "chmod 0600" in bad.stderr, bad
os.chmod(kf,0o600); EXTRA=["--policy-dir",pd,"--bundle-key",kf]
sv=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"_tools/coord.py","--store",os.path.join(d,"c.sqlite"),"serve","--bind","127.0.0.1:0","--keys",kd]+EXTRA,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
url=sv.stdout.readline().split("serving")[1].strip()
b=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url+"/v1/bundles/kbjobs.tar.gz",headers={"Authorization":" ".join(["Bearer",open(a).read()])}),timeout=30).read(); sv.terminate()
t=tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(b)); files={m.name.lstrip("./"):t.extractfile(m).read() for m in t.getmembers() if m.isfile()}
jwt=json.loads(files.pop(".signatures.json"))["signatures"][0]; h,p,sg=jwt.split(".")
pad=lambda s: base64.urlsafe_b64decode(s+"="*(-len(s)%4))
assert hmac.compare_digest(pad(sg),hmac.new(open(kf,"rb").read(),f"{h}.{p}".encode(),hashlib.sha256).digest())
listed={f["name"].lstrip("/"):f["hash"] for f in json.loads(pad(p))["files"]}
assert all(hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest()==listed[k] for k,v in files.items() if k in listed) and listed, listed
assert hashlib.sha256(files[[k for k in files if k.endswith(".rego")][0]]+b"x").hexdigest() not in listed.values()
